name: run-lumen
before: (async () => { const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const press = (root, text) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll(root + ' button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === text); if (b) { b.click(); } return b ? text : 'no ' + text; }; const sel = document.querySelector('#connection select'); const opt = [...sel.options].find((o) => /LUMEN/i.test(o.value + o.textContent)); sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); press('#connection', 'Connect'); await wait(500); return 'ready'; })()
